PROGRESS NOTE (SOAP) Teche Valley General Hospital Hospital Medicine Clinic August 11, 2064 Patient: Fontenot, Leonard MRN: LGH-6043-2217 DOB: 01/19/2027 Age: 37 Physician: Tobias Wren, MD
Dictating the progress note for Mr. Fontenot, this is a thirty-seven-year-old man here for his annual wellness examination and follow up of chronic sinusitis, social isolation, and substance use.
SUBJECTIVE: He says his sinuses are better since the surgery discussion and the nasal spray, but his pain is four out of ten, mostly low back and neck. He has been clean from pills, he says, for about one year, going to meetings. Home situation: his wife Delphine and he separated for several weeks and he stayed with his father Armand, who is now ninety-four, at the duplex on Coulee Rouge Lane. Delphine's grandfather Emile Guidry passed away at 97 last spring. Children Remy, now twelve, and Odile, nine, are doing well at school. Neighbor Mrs. Thibodeaux lost her husband. He reports that at times his partner has been physically aggressive during arguments, he has bruises he attributes to this, and he does not want police involved. He still works at Bayou Teche Sheet Metal Works. The landlord, Gaspard Hebert, is selling the duplex.
OBJECTIVE: Weight 105.5 kilograms, BMI 28.8, blood pressure 119 over 94, pain 4. Total cholesterol 220.7, LDL 141.4. GAD-7 is 3. Alert, oriented, no acute distress. Forearm bruising yellow-green, bilateral, healing. Nasal mucosa pink.
ASSESSMENT: 1. Intimate partner violence, patient is victim. 2. Hyperlipidemia, LDL high. 3. Chronic sinusitis, stable. 4. Opioid misuse in remission. 5. Anxiety, mild. PLAN: Safety plan reviewed, hotline number given, social work Ms. Achebe to follow up. Start statin discussion, recheck lipids in three months. Medication reconciliation done: diphenhydramine, epinephrine auto-injector carried. Return in six months, or February 2065.
Phone for patient (337) 555-0183. Wife email delphine.fontenot@bayoumail.example. Dictated by Tobias Wren, MD on 08/11/2064 at 17:55. Dictated but not read. Electronically signed by T. Wren 8/12/2064 07:03
